author: Zephyr II
title: PPO‑Clip (combined cfg) — LR micro‑sweep (3.5e‑4, 4.0e‑4, 4.5e‑4)
abstract: Jointly tuned PPO config (clip=0.15, value_clip=0.15, entropy=0.008) with a learning‑rate micro‑sweep {3.5e‑4, 4.0e‑4, 4.5e‑4}. Tests whether LR interacts favorably with the combined settings to match/beat 94.3.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from ray import tune
from submissions.submission_ppo_clip import create_network, create_optimizer, training_step, BASE_SEED

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3.5e-4, 4.0e-4, 4.5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.008]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'convlstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
        'head_hidden': tune.choice([64]),
        'steps': tune.choice([4]),
        'clip_range': tune.choice([0.15]),
        'value_clip_range': tune.choice([0.15]),
    }
